'''Chapter 987''' is titled "The Brocade of Loyal Retainers".{{Sort}}

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page#Color Spread|Color Spread]]: The [[Straw Hat Pirates]] with [[wikipedia:Pug|pugs]].

On the bottom left, the text reads "We're gonna live like tomorrow doesn't exist".

==Short Summary==
The [[Nine Red Scabbards]] manage to pierce their weapons through [[Kaidou]]'s skin with their [[Haki/Armament Haki|Ryuo]], and all-out war breaks out in the Skull Dome as the [[Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance]]'s forces mobilize. While [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] confronts [[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]], Kaidou emerges from the attack with minor wounds and flies to the roof of the dome in his dragon form. The Scabbards follow him up, and face off with him under the light of the full moon. The [[Mink Tribe]] forces then join the Scabbards, and they along with [[Inuarashi]] and [[Nekomamushi]] begin activating their Sulong forms.

==Long Summary==
As [[Kaidou]] is forced off of the Performance Stage by the [[Nine Red Scabbards]], he remembers [[Kouzuki Oden]] giving him his lone scar 20 years ago, and then recalls Oden's execution where the samurai enabled his retainers to escape and warned Kaidou not to underestimate Wano's samurai. [[Kin'emon]] manages to plunge his sword into Kaidou's body, and the other Scabbards are able to quickly follow suit. The scar Kaidou got from Oden begins throbbing, and the Emperor begins screaming in pain as he realizes the Scabbards are using Oden's [[Haki/Armament Haki|Ryuo]].

After a long fall, the Scabbards and Kaidou crash into the ground, leaving a large crater. The [[Beasts Pirates]] nearby quickly rush to attack, but [[Hyougoro]]'s forces stand in their way as they cast aside their pirate disguises. As [[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]] looks on at the incident, [[Yamato]] goes with [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] to the scene to help finish Kaidou off. However, [[Ulti]] finds Yamato again and attacks with a spiked club, which Yamato parries wielding the kanabo. Ulti says she will have revenge for Yamato's attack against her and wonders why Yamato would do something like that; Yamato replies that this is the day where he will fully become Kouzuki Oden, which only confuses Ulti. The Beasts Pirates then call out to Yamato to inform him of the attack on Kaidou, but Yamato bluntly states that they are no longer allies and there will be no concern of Kaidou's death.

Big Mom then comes running toward Luffy, and when she does, [[Nami]] and [[Carrot]] quickly take the opportunity to respectively use the [[Sorcery Clima-Tact|Clima-Tact]] and [[Electro]] to free themselves from the [[homies]] restraining them. Luffy is not pleased to see Big Mom due to being busy, and she states that she came here just to kill him. Meanwhile, Kaidou emerges from the floor with several stab wounds, but is not much worse for wear. He notes that [[Orochi]]'s paranoid ideas ended up being reality, with the Scabbards having been able to operate under the shadow of the [[Straw Hat Pirates]]. He says that pirates will betray them, though, and that the forces that the samurai have worked to gather will abandon them once it is clear they will lose, with Luffy already having lost to him once. However, Kin'emon denounces Kaidou's words as slander, saying that Luffy will one day stand at the pinnacle of the seas and no matter what happens, he will remain and achieve the promise of daybreak coming back to Wano.

Back on the Performance Floor, Big Mom asks Luffy why he came here, being incredulous that he seriously intends to take on Kaidou. To his allies' surprise, Luffy denies it, but then instead says that he came to defeat all of his enemies here in an all-out war. Big Mom and [[Queen]] quickly laugh at this, but Queen is then alerted to thousands of samurai invading through the rear entrance. These forces include the Rasetsu Town prisoners, Udon prisoners, the [[Heart Pirates]], and even [[Polo Marco|Marco]] and [[Perospero]] approaching the entrance. Queen orders all of the Beasts Pirates to grab their weapons, proclaiming that the party is over. Kaidou then shouts out from behind the stage, saying he accepts Luffy's challenge. He proceeds to fly to the roof of the Skull Dome in his dragon form, and as the Scabbards hold onto his body to follow him up, Luffy tells Kin'emon he will catch up with them later. Kaidou faces off with the Scabbards on the Dome Roof, saying he has sobered up and that a battle in open space is best, just like their last one, although now Oden is dead. However, [[Nekomamushi]] replies that there is another difference between that day and now, as since they anticipated Kaidou intending to fight outdoors, they have brought the forces of the [[Mink Tribe]] with them. Nekomamushi then gazes at the full moon, beginning to activate [[Sulong]].

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*The [[Nine Red Scabbards|Scabbards]] manage to wound [[Kaidou]].
*[[Hyougoro]] and the disguised [[samurai]] start fighting the [[Beasts Pirates]].
*[[Yamato]] engages [[Ulti]] in combat.
**Yamato also declares himself to no longer be an ally of the Beasts Pirates.
*[[Nami]] and [[Carrot]] free themselves from [[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom's]] [[Homies]].
*Big Mom confronts [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] again.
*[[Polo Marco|Marco]] and [[Charlotte Perospero|Perospero]] arrive at [[Onigashima]] together.
*After he is informed of the situation regarding the strength of the enemy forces, [[Queen]] gives the orders for the Beasts Pirates to mobilize in full force.
*Kaidou transforms into his dragon form and flies away with the Scabbards, taking his fight with them outside his castle at the summit of the Skull Dome.
**The [[Mink Tribe]] joins the Scabbards, and [[Nekomamushi]] sees a [[Moon|full moon]].

==Trivia==
*The chapter's title is possibly a reference to {{Nihongo|[[Wikipedia:Chūshingura|Chūshingura]]|忠臣蔵|The Treasury of Loyal Retainers}}, a fictionalized account of an event in which [[Wikipedia:Forty-seven rōnin|forty-seven rōnin]] avenged [[Wikipedia:Asano Naganori|their master's]] death. The chapter title replaces {{Nihongo|"treasury"|蔵}} with {{Nihongo|"brocade"|錦}}, the same kanji symbol used in {{Nihongo|[[Kin'emon|Kin'emon's]]|錦えもん}} name.
